comparison.objective: Candidate configures a gripper stop; this record mounts a shaft between fixed and spring-loaded bench centres.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses coaxial driver/wrench countertorque; the record holds a tailstock lever retracted while seating and pivoting a shaft onto two conical points.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angular travel; the record checks both centre points properly seated, lever returned, shaft still, hands clear, and no damaging ram/drop.
comparison.reason: Lever-held precision shaft seating tests alignment and compliant insertion, not threaded setting and lock retention.
